description: This file contains API helper functions for managing test runs, including listing test cases, triggering test runs, fetching test run details and logs, and canceling test runs. It wraps API endpoints related to test execution in a testing automation suite.

methods.name: requestJson
methods.description: Internal helper for making JSON HTTP requests, handling response parsing and errors.

methods.name: listAllTestCases
methods.description: Lists available test cases for test runs, with fallback on errors.

methods.name: triggerTestRun
methods.description: Triggers a new test run for a specified test case, optionally with metadata.

methods.name: getTestRun
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific test run by ID.

methods.name: getTestRunLogs
methods.description: Retrieves logs for a specific test run, returning text or JSON lines.

methods.name: cancelTestRun
methods.description: Attempts to cancel a specific test run if supported by backend.
